questions.title: First unique character
questions.statement: Return the index of the first character in s that appears exactly once. Return -1 if there is none.
questions.hint_policy: Conceptual help only; no solution code.

rubric.core_idea: Count frequencies in one pass, then scan in order for the first count of 1.
rubric.complexity: O(n) time, O(k) extra space; contrast with O(n^2) nested scanning.
rubric.edge_cases: Empty string, all characters repeated, single character.

questions.title: Most common character
questions.statement: Return the character that appears most often in s. If several tie, return the one that appears first in s. Return None for an empty string.
questions.hint_policy: Conceptual help only; no solution code.

rubric.core_idea: Count frequencies with a dict, then pick the max while respecting first-occurrence order for ties.
